meta.title: Mihomo Subscription Converter
meta.description: Mihomo / Clash config generator supporting Hysteria2, AnyTLS, VLESS, Trojan, VMess, Shadowsocks, TUIC

step1.title: Proxy Node Links
step1.placeholder:

# anytls://password@host:port?peer=sni&insecure=1#NodeName

# trojan://password@host:port?sni=xxx#NodeName
# vmess://base64...
# ss://method:password@host:port#NodeName

guide.title: Quick Guide
items: Paste proxy links, a converter URL, a base64 subscription, or Clash YAML proxies — nodes are extracted locally
Click Generate — a live subscription URL is created on your deploy
Paste the URL into Clash Verge / Clash Party / Clash Mi
guide.footnote: Rule sets are powered by {metacubex} and fetched via jsDelivr (testingcf) so they load in mainland China.

result.urlDescription: Paste the following URL into your Clash / Mihomo client as a remote profile:
usageItems: Paste the URL into Clash Verge / Clash Party / Clash Mi or any compatible client

Rule sets are downloaded automatically by the client on first load
